steps.code: npm i next react react-dom nextra nextra-theme-docs

steps.en: Wrap your Next config once so Markdown is handled
steps.zh: 把 Next 配置包一层，让它处理 Markdown

steps.en: Write the site shell once, feeding it the page map
steps.zh: 写一次站点外壳，把 page map 交给它

steps.en: Treats each Markdown/MDX file as a page and derives the sidebar
steps.zh: 把每个 Markdown／MDX 文件当成页面，并推导出侧边栏
启动 Next.js 开发服务器

value.en: Every new Markdown file is a page in a Next.js app — the docs layer is four packages, not a preset
value.zh: 每个新的 Markdown 文件都是 Next.js 应用里的一个页面——文档层是四个包，不是一套预设

sources: https://nextra.site/docs/docs-theme/start (Install: 'npm i next react react-dom nextra nextra-theme-docs'; package.json scripts dev/build/start as next / next build / next start; next.config.mjs with 'import nextra from nextra' and withNextra({...}); app/layout.jsx using Footer, Layout, Navbar from nextra-theme-docs, getPageMap from nextra/page-map, and importing nextra-theme-docs/style.css; 'npm run dev' to run the project)
https://nextra.site/docs/file-conventions (page.mdx file convention, content directory, _meta.js for ordering)
README.md ('Simple, powerful and flexible site generation framework with everything you love from Next.js')
